authentication: OIDC bearer identity and enrolled device proof

sessionAuthorization.ownDevices: current approved devices of the owner
sessionAuthorization.friends: explicit membership in the selected live publication
sessionAuthorization.administration: owner; membership updates require the hosting device

sessionPublication.membershipMutation: replace chosen friend IDs with expected authorizationRevision
sessionPublication.revocation: advance the revision; close the relay pipes of removed people and devices at once; tell the host
sessionPublication.missingRecovery: current hosting device may republish same still-live incarnation with owner-only access

deviceLink.code: 12 random symbols of Crockford base 32 (60 bits) that the new device makes and shows; the server never gets it
deviceLink.key: PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512, 1048576 rounds, password = the code as shown, salt = kodosi-device-link-v1 and the 16-byte nonce of the request, 32 bytes
deviceLink.requestProof: HMAC-SHA256 with the key over the length-prefixed fields: request, account id, device id, label, signing key, KEM key
deviceLink.approvalProof: HMAC-SHA256 with the key over the length-prefixed fields: approval, account id, device id, identity root
deviceLink.identityRoot: SHA-256 of kodosi-identity-root-v1 and the certificate body of the one self-signed device of the account
deviceLink.request: the new device sends its device id, label, signing key, KEM key, nonce and request proof; at most 5 open requests for each account; 10 minutes, which the new device also counts itself
deviceLink.approve: the approving device signs only the request whose request proof holds for the code that the user typed, and sends the approval proof
deviceLink.accept: the new device takes the account identity only when the approval proof holds for the identity root of the identity that it reads
deviceLink.server: stores and lists the requests and the two proofs; makes and checks no code

friendIdentity.record: for each friend the user keeps: handle, identity root (absent until the first read), verified
friendIdentity.list: JSON of the records with the account id, a revision and the signing device id; signed with ML-DSA-65 over kodosi-friend-list-v1 and the body by an approved device of the account
friendIdentity.storage: the server stores the newest signed list of each account and replaces it only from the revision that the device read; it cannot make or change a list
friendIdentity.use: a device reads the identity of another account only with a record, and only when the identity root is equal to the root of the record
friendIdentity.created: by the user: a friend request, an accepted request, Trust, or Verify with an invite text
friendIdentity.hint: the friend list from the server gives identityIncarnationId for each friend so that a device can show a changed identity early; the hint is not trusted

missionContent: directory metadata only; no chat, tasks, or agent dispatch
backendSecrets: none; the server relays TLS records between a host device and a viewer device and holds no terminal key
